title: Plate Continuity Series
description: Four reference-linked fine-dining plates establishing a disciplined black-plate language.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the plate diameter, camera height, negative-space ratio, and light discipline. Images 02-04 keep that exact plating system while shifting the hero ingredient, sauce choreography, and garnish logic.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-black-plate-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for the remaining series images. Queue may run the dependent variations concurrently after the reference is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
